records.jp: 探索：目標の確認
records.en_original: Exploration: Objectives
records.en: Exploration: Objectives

records.jp: 画面右側には、現在の目標が表示されています。^00また、<IM20>を押すと、これまでの物語のあらすじを確認することができます
records.en_original: You can see your current objective on the right side of the screen. You can also press <IM20> to see a summary of the story so far.
records.en_auxiliary: You can see your current objective on the right side of the screen. You can also press <IM20> to see a summary of the story so far.
records.en: You can see your current objective on the right side of the screen.^00You can also press <IM20> to see a summary of the story so far.

records.jp: 探索：採取
records.en_original: Exploration: Collecting Items
records.en: Exploration: Collecting Items

records.jp: フィールドに点在する光るオブジェクトを調べると、アイテムを入手することができます。^00採取可能な場所は、ミニマップ上で緑の点として表示されます。^00入手したアイテムは、メインメニューの「アイテム」から確認できます
records.en_original: You can obtain items by examining the glowing objects you find while exploring. Places you can collect items will be shown as green dots on the mini-map. You can see the items you have collected in the Main Menu under Items.
records.en_auxiliary: You can obtain items by examining the glowing objects you find while exploring. Places you can collect items will be shown as green dots on the mini-map. You can see the items you have collected in the Main Menu under Items.
records.en: You can obtain items by examining the glowing objects you find while exploring.^00Places you can collect items will be shown as green dots on the mini-map.^00You can see the items you have collected in the Main Menu under Items.

records.jp: 探索：敵シンボル
records.en_original: Exploration: Enemies
records.en: Exploration: Enemies

records.jp: フィールドの敵シンボルに接触すると、戦闘が始まります。^00また、フィールドでは<IM04>で武器を振ることができます。^00敵シンボルに武器を当てると先制攻撃となり、<CLGR>中央に配置したキャラクターのエーテルが蓄積した状態で戦闘を開始<CLNR>することができます
records.en_original: When you come into contact with an enemy, a battle will begin. You can also initiate combat by swinging your weapon at the enemy with <IM04>. Initiating combat with your weapon gives you an advantage, granting <CLGR>all your allies' Ether<CLNR> at the start of battle.
records.en_auxiliary: When you come into contact with an enemy, a battle will begin. You can also initiate combat by swinging your weapon at the enemy with <IM04>. Initiating combat with your weapon gives you an advantage, granting <CLGR>all your allies' Ether<CLNR> at the start of battle.
records.en: Coming into contact with an enemy symbol starts a battle.^00You can also swing your weapon in the field with <IM04>.^00If you hit an enemy symbol with your weapon, you will launch a preemptive attack and <CLGR>begin battle with the character in the center position's Ether already charged<CLNR>.

records.jp: 探索：全体マップ
records.en_original: Exploration: Map
records.en: Exploration: Map

records.jp: 探索地で<IM11>を押すと、全体マップが開きます。^00マップを開いた後、<IM25>を押すことで、<CLGR>探索を中断し学校に戻る<CLNR>ことができます
records.en_original: Press <IM11> while exploring to open the map. While the map is open, you can press <IM25> to stop exploring and return to the school.
records.en_auxiliary: Press <IM11> while exploring to open the map. While the map is open, you can press <IM25> to stop exploring and return to the school.
records.en: Press <IM11> while exploring to open the map.^00While the map is open, press <IM25> to <CLGR>stop exploring and return to school<CLNR>.

records.jp: 探索：ミニマップ
records.en_original: Exploration: Mini-Map
records.en: Exploration: Mini-Map

records.jp: ミニマップには、愛央の周囲の情報が表示されます。^00ＮＰＣや敵、採取ポイントの他、現在の目標となる場所も表示されます
records.en_original: The mini-map displays information about Ao's surroundings, such as NPCs, enemies, and collection points, as well as the current objective.
records.en_auxiliary: The mini-map displays information about Ao's surroundings, such as NPCs, enemies, and collection points, as well as the current objective.
records.en: The mini-map displays information about Ao's surroundings.^00It shows NPCs, enemies, gathering points, and the location of your current objective.

records.jp: 探索：障害物
records.en_original: Exploration: Obstacles
records.en: Exploration: Obstacles

records.jp: 探索地の一部には、障害物によって封鎖されている道があります。^00特定の工作アイテムを使用したり、特定のキャラクターのタレントレベルを上昇させたりすることによって、封鎖を解除することができます
records.en_original: While exploring, you may find that some of the paths are blocked by obstacles. You can remove them by using certain crafted items or by increasing the talent level of certain characters.
records.en_auxiliary: While exploring, you may find that some of the paths are blocked by obstacles. You can remove them by using certain crafted items or by increasing the talent level of certain characters.
records.en: While exploring, you may find that some of the paths are blocked by obstacles.^00You can remove them by using certain crafted items or by increasing the talent level of certain characters.

records.jp: 戦闘：戦闘の基本
records.en_original: Battle: Combat Basics
records.en: Battle: Combat Basics

records.jp: 戦闘では、敵のＨＰを０にすることで勝利になります。^00戦闘をしているキャラクター全員のＨＰが０になると敗北となり、強制的に学校に戻されます
records.en_original: In battle, victory is achieved by reducing the enemy's HP to 0. If the HP of all the characters in battle reaches 0, you will be defeated and forced to return to the school.
records.en_auxiliary: In battle, victory is achieved by reducing the enemy's HP to 0. If the HP of all the characters in battle reaches 0, you will be defeated and forced to return to the school.
records.en: In battle, victory is achieved by reducing the enemy's HP to 0.^00If the HP of all the characters in battle reaches 0, you will be defeated and forced to return to the school.

records.jp: 戦闘：エーテル
records.en_original: Battle: Ether
records.en: Battle: Ether

records.jp: 戦闘中は、時間経過に応じてエーテルが蓄積します。^00タイムライン上のアイコンの位置は、蓄積しているエーテル量と対応しています。^00タイムラインの行動可能ラインを超えたキャラクターは、<CLGR>エーテルを消費してスキルを発動<CLNR>できます
records.en_original: Ether accumulates as time passes in battle. The position of the characters' icons on the Timeline corresponds to the amount of Ether they have accumulated. Characters whose icons have crossed the Action Line can <CLGR>use Ether to activate their skills<CLGR>.
records.en_auxiliary: Ether accumulates as time passes in battle. The position of the characters' icons on the Timeline corresponds to the amount of Ether they have accumulated. Characters whose icons have crossed the Action Line can <CLGR>use Ether to activate their skills<CLGR>.
records.en: Ether accumulates as time passes in battle.^00The position of each icon on the Timeline corresponds to the amount of Ether that character has accumulated.^00Characters whose icons cross the Action Line can <CLGR>spend Ether to activate skills<CLNR>.

records.jp: 戦闘：エーテル回復速度
records.en_original: Battle: Ether Recovery Speed
records.en: Battle: Ether Recovery Speed

records.jp: スキルを発動すると<CLGR>エーテルの回復速度が上昇<CLNR>し、次にスキルを発動できるようになるまでの時間が短くなります。^00エーテルの回復速度はｅ／ｓ（１秒間に溜まるエーテル回復速度）と表記されることもあります
records.en_original: When you activate a skill, the <CLGR>Ether recovery speed increases<CLNR>, reducing the time until you can activate a skill again. The Ether recovery speed is sometimes displayed as e/s (amount of Ether recovered per second).
records.en_auxiliary: When you activate a skill, the <CLGR>Ether recovery speed increases<CLNR>, reducing the time until you can activate a skill again. The Ether recovery speed is sometimes displayed as e/s (amount of Ether recovered per second).
records.en: When you activate a skill, the <CLGR>Ether recovery speed increases<CLNR>, reducing the time until you can activate a skill again.^00The Ether recovery speed is sometimes displayed as e/s (amount of Ether recovered per second).

records.jp: 戦闘：ギア
records.en_original: Battle: Gears
records.en: Battle: Gears

records.jp: エーテル回復速度が一定以上になると、ギアが上がります。^00ギアが上がるとスキルが強化され、エーテルの上限が上昇します。また、使用できるスキルの種類が増える場合もあります。^00エーテルの上限が上昇した状態でエーテルをたくさん溜めると、<CLGR>連続してスキルを発動させる<CLNR>こともできるようになります
records.en_original: When the Ether recovery speed has reached a certain level, you will shift Gears. As your Gear increases, your skills will become more powerful and your Ether limit will be raised. It can also increase the types of skills you can use. If you accumulate a lot of Ether while your Ether limit is raised, you will be able to use <CLGR>multiple skills in succession<CLNR>.
records.en_auxiliary: When the Ether recovery speed has reached a certain level, you will shift Gears. As your Gear increases, your skills will become more powerful and your Ether limit will be raised. It can also increase the types of skills you can use. If you accumulate a lot of Ether while your Ether limit is raised, you will be able to use <CLGR>multiple skills in succession<CLNR>.
records.en: Your Gear increases once your Ether recovery speed reaches certain thresholds.^00Higher Gears strengthen your skills, raise your maximum Ether, and may unlock additional skills.^00By building up plenty of Ether after raising the maximum, you can also <CLGR>activate several skills in succession<CLNR>.

records.jp: 戦闘：コンボ
records.en_original: Battle: Combos
records.en: Battle: Combos

records.jp: 味方が攻撃をするとコンボが発生します。^00コンボを繋ぐことで、敵に与えられるダメージに補正がかかり、<CLGR>大きなダメージを与えることができる<CLNR>ようになります
records.en_original: When an ally attacks, a combo is started. Adding to the combo will increase your damage modifier, <CLGR>allowing you to deal more damage<CLNR>.
records.en_auxiliary: When an ally attacks, a combo is started. Adding to the combo will increase your damage modifier, <CLGR>allowing you to deal more damage<CLNR>.
records.en: A combo begins when an ally attacks.^00Extending the combo increases the damage modifier, <CLGR>allowing you to deal greater damage<CLNR>.

records.jp: 戦闘：コンボガード
records.en_original: Battle: Combo Guard
records.en: Battle: Combo Guard

records.jp: 一部の敵が放つ強力な攻撃には、コンボをリセットさせる効果があります。^00愛央などが持つ<CLGR>コンボのリセットを防ぐスキル<CLNR>を使用することで、コンボのリセットを防ぐことができます
records.en_original: Some enemies will unleash powerful attacks that can reset your combo. Using Ao and friends' <CLGR>combo reset prevention skill<CLNR> will prevent your combo from being reset!
records.en_auxiliary: Some enemies will unleash powerful attacks that can reset your combo. Using Ao and friends' <CLGR>combo reset prevention skill<CLNR> will prevent your combo from being reset!
records.en: Some enemies have powerful attacks that reset your combo.^00Using <CLGR>a skill that prevents combo resets<CLNR>, such as one of Ao's, will keep the combo from being reset.

records.jp: 戦闘：操作モードの切替
records.en_original: Battle: Switching Battle Modes
records.en: Battle: Switching Battle Modes

records.jp: 戦闘中に<IM09>を押すと、マニュアルモードとオートモードが切り替わります。^00マニュアルモードでは、左右のキャラクターに<IM13>・<IM17>で指示を出すことができます。^00オートモードでは、左右のキャラクターは指示を出さなくても自動で行動します
records.en_original: Pressing <IM09> during battle will toggle between Manual Mode and Auto Mode. In Manual Mode, you can give instructions to the characters on the left and right using <IM13> and <IM17>. In Auto Mode, the left and right characters will take their actions automatically without being given instructions.
records.en_auxiliary: Pressing <IM09> during battle will toggle between Manual Mode and Auto Mode. In Manual Mode, you can give instructions to the characters on the left and right using <IM13> and <IM17>. In Auto Mode, the left and right characters will take their actions automatically without being given instructions.
records.en: Pressing <IM09> during battle will toggle between Manual Mode and Auto Mode.^00In Manual Mode, you can give instructions to the characters on the left and right using <IM13> and <IM17>.^00In Auto Mode, the left and right characters will take their actions automatically without being given instructions.

records.jp: 戦闘：ノックダウン
records.en_original: Battle: Knockdown
records.en: Battle: Knockdown

records.jp: 連続して攻撃を受けた敵や味方は、ノックダウンすることがあります。^00ノックダウンすると、蓄積したエーテルを失い、エーテル回復速度が低下します。^00さらに、ノックダウン後は一定時間行動不能になるため、攻撃をたたみかけて大ダメージを与えるチャンスです。^00攻撃を受け続けてノックダウンしそうになった場合は、行動をすることで状態をリセットできます
records.en_original: Enemies and allies who take repeated attacks may be knocked down. When knocked down, all accumulated Ether is lost and Ether recovery speed decreases. In addition, enemies in Knockdown will be temporarily unable to move, giving you a chance to attack and deal massive damage. If you are taking repeated attacks and Knockdown seems imminent, you can reset your status by taking an action.
records.en_auxiliary: Enemies and allies who take repeated attacks may be knocked down. When knocked down, all accumulated Ether is lost and Ether recovery speed decreases. In addition, enemies in Knockdown will be temporarily unable to move, giving you a chance to attack and deal massive damage. If you are taking repeated attacks and Knockdown seems imminent, you can reset your status by taking an action.
records.en: Enemies and allies may be knocked down after taking repeated attacks.^00Knockdown removes all accumulated Ether and lowers Ether recovery speed.^00A knocked-down character is unable to act for a short time, giving the opposing side a chance to press the attack and deal heavy damage.^00If repeated attacks are bringing you close to Knockdown, taking an action will reset the buildup.

records.jp: 戦闘：情報確認画面
records.en_original: Battle: Information Scanner
records.en: Battle: Information Screen

records.jp: 戦闘中に<IM19>を押すと、戦闘を一時停止して敵味方の状態を表示します。^00それぞれが持つ属性耐性や、発生している補助効果や状態異常、ステータス変化などを確認できます
records.en_original: Pressing <IM19> during battle will pause the battle and display the status of the enemy and allies. You can view their attribute resistances, as well as any support effects, status ailments, or status changes in effect.
records.en_auxiliary: Pressing <IM19> during battle will pause the battle and display the status of the enemy and allies. You can view their attribute resistances, as well as any support effects, status ailments, or status changes in effect.
records.en: Press <IM19> during battle to pause and display information on allies and enemies.^00You can check their elemental resistances, active support effects and status ailments, and any stat changes.

records.jp: 戦闘：属性
records.en_original: Battle: Attributes
records.en: Battle: Attributes

records.jp: 一部の攻撃スキルには属性が設定されています。^00敵の弱点属性で攻撃をすることで、より大きなダメージを与えることができますが、逆に耐性属性で攻撃するとダメージが減ってしまいます
records.en_original: Some attack skills have certain attributes. You can do more damage to an enemy by using attacks with attributes that it is weak to, but those it is resistant to do less damage.
records.en_auxiliary: Some attack skills have certain attributes. You can do more damage to an enemy by using attacks with attributes that it is weak to, but those it is resistant to do less damage.
records.en: Some attack skills have an element.^00Attacking with an element the enemy is weak against deals more damage, while using an element it resists deals less.

records.jp: 戦闘：補助効果と状態異常
records.en_original: Battle: Support Effects and Status Ailments
records.en_auxiliary: Battle: Support Effects and Status Ailments
records.en: Battle: Support Effects and Status Ailments

records.jp: 一部のスキルは、敵や味方に様々な効果を付与します。^00有利な影響を与える補助効果と、不利な影響を与える状態異常があり、どちらも決められた時間キャラクターに効果を与え続けます
records.en_original: Some skills have various effects on enemies and allies. Support effects have a positive impact and status ailments have a negative impact. They both affect the character for a set amount of time.
records.en_auxiliary: Some skills have various effects on enemies and allies. Support effects have a positive impact and status ailments have a negative impact. They both affect the character for a set amount of time.
records.en: Some skills apply various effects to allies or enemies.^00Support effects provide advantages, while status ailments impose disadvantages. Both remain active for a set duration.

records.jp: 戦闘：補助効果
records.en_original: Battle: Support Effects
records.en: Battle: Support Effects

records.jp: 継続ＨＰ回復　　：一定時間ごとにＨＰが回復する。^00状態異常無効　　：状態異常を無効化する。^00被ダメージ減少　：受けるダメージが一定の割合減少する。^00ノックダウン耐性：ノックダウンしづらくなる。^00与ダメージ上昇　：与えるダメージが一定の割合上昇する。^00ノックダウン強化：敵をノックダウンさせやすくなる。^00シールド属性付与：属性スキル発動時、シールド属性が^00　　　　　　　　　付与されるようになる。
records.en_original: HP Regen: Recovers HP at regular intervals.^00Ailment Immunity: Makes user immune to certain status ailments.^00Damage Taken Down: Reduces damage taken by a certain percentage.^00Knockdown Resist: Makes you harder to knock down.^00Damage Dealt Up: Increases damage dealt by a certain percentage.^00Knockdown Boost: Makes it easier to knock down enemies.^00Shield Attribute: Shield attribute granted when using attribute skills.
records.en_auxiliary: HP Regen: Recovers HP at regular intervals.^00Ailment Immunity: Makes user immune to certain status ailments.^00Damage Taken Down: Reduces damage taken by a certain percentage.^00Knockdown Resist: Makes you harder to knock down.^00Damage Dealt Up: Increases damage dealt by a certain percentage.^00Knockdown Boost: Makes it easier to knock down enemies.^00Shield Attribute: Shield attribute granted when using attribute skills.
records.en: HP Regen: Restores HP at regular intervals.^00Ailment Immunity: Prevents status ailments.^00Damage Taken Down: Reduces damage taken by a set percentage.^00Knockdown Resist: Makes the target harder to knock down.^00Damage Dealt Up: Increases damage dealt by a set percentage.^00Knockdown Boost: Makes enemies easier to knock down.^00Shield Element: Using an elemental skill also grants^00the corresponding Shield Element.

records.jp: 戦闘：状態異常
records.en_original: Battle: Status Ailments
records.en: Battle: Status Ailments

records.jp: 麻痺　：行動できなくなる。^00毒　　：一定時間ごとにダメージを受ける。^00暗闇　：一定確率で攻撃が外れる。^00スロウ：エーテル回復速度が低下する。^00呪い　：ＨＰが回復しなくなる。^00出血　：一定時間ごとにダメージを受ける。時間経過で回復しない。
records.en_original: Paralysis: Prevents actions from being taken.^00Poison: Inflicts damage over time.^00Blind: Causes attacks to miss at a certain rate.^00Slow: Decreases Ether recovery speed.^00Curse: Stops all HP recovery.^00Bleed: Inflicts damage over time. Effects do not subside over time.
records.en_auxiliary: Paralysis: Prevents actions from being taken.^00Poison: Inflicts damage over time.^00Blind: Causes attacks to miss at a certain rate.^00Slow: Decreases Ether recovery speed.^00Curse: Stops all HP recovery.^00Bleed: Inflicts damage over time. Effects do not subside over time.
records.en: Paralysis: Prevents the target from acting.^00Poison: Deals damage at regular intervals.^00Blind: Gives attacks a chance to miss.^00Slow: Lowers Ether recovery speed.^00Curse: Prevents HP recovery.^00Bleed: Deals damage at regular intervals and does not wear off over time.

records.jp: 戦闘：ステータス
records.en_original: Battle: Status
records.en: Battle: Status

records.jp: キャラクターのステータスは、そのキャラクターの強さの指標になります。^00　^00Ｌｖ．：Ｌｖ．が上がるごとにステータスが上昇する。^00ＨＰ　：ダメージを受けると減り、０になると戦闘不能になる。^00攻撃力：敵に与えるダメージに影響する。^00防御力：敵から受けるダメージに影響する。
records.en_original: A character's status indicates their strength.^00^00Lv.: Status increases as Lv. increases.^00HP: Decreases when taking damage. Character will fall when it reaches 0.^00Attack: Determines damage dealt to enemies.^00Defense: Determines damage taken from enemies.
records.en_auxiliary: A character's status indicates their strength.^00^00Lv.: Status increases as Lv. increases.^00HP: Decreases when taking damage. Character will fall when it reaches 0.^00Attack: Determines damage dealt to enemies.^00Defense: Determines damage taken from enemies.
records.en: A character's stats indicate their combat strength.^00^00Lv.: Raising the character's Lv. increases their stats.^00HP: Decreases when taking damage. Reaching 0 causes the character to be knocked out.^00Attack: Affects damage dealt to enemies.^00Defense: Affects damage taken from enemies.

records.jp: 戦闘：サポーターメニュー
records.en_original: Battle: Supporter Menu
records.en: Battle: Supporter Menu

records.jp: サポーターを編成中に、<IM04>で開くことのできるメニューです。^00サポーターメニューでは、サポーターに指示を出したり、サポーターの情報を見たりすることができます
records.en_original: Press <IM04> to open this menu while organizing your Supporters. You can give instructions to your Supporters and view their information in the Supporter menu.
records.en_auxiliary: Press <IM04> to open this menu while organizing your Supporters. You can give instructions to your Supporters and view their information in the Supporter menu.
records.en: This menu can be opened with <IM04> while Supporters are assigned.^00The Supporter Menu lets you issue instructions to Supporters and view their information.

records.jp: 戦闘：オーダーリング
records.en_original: Battle: Order Ring
records.en: Battle: Order Ring

records.jp: サポーターを編成中に、画面左側に表示されているリング状のゲージです。^00ゲージは時間経過で蓄積し、１周すると元に戻ります。周回数に応じて、<CLGR>サポーターに設定されたサポートオーダーが発動<CLNR>します
records.en_original: This is the ring-shaped gauge that appears on the left side of the screen while you are organizing your Supporters. The gauge will accumulate over time and reset after one round. The <CLGR>support orders set for the Supporters will be activated<CLNR> based on the number of cycles completed.
records.en_auxiliary: This is the ring-shaped gauge that appears on the left side of the screen while you are organizing your Supporters. The gauge will accumulate over time and reset after one round. The <CLGR>support orders set for the Supporters will be activated<CLNR> based on the number of cycles completed.
records.en: This ring-shaped gauge appears on the left side of the screen while Supporters are assigned.^00It fills over time and resets after completing a cycle. <CLGR>Support Orders assigned to each Supporter activate<CLNR> according to the number of completed cycles.

records.jp: 戦闘：サポートオーダー
records.en_original: Battle: Support Orders
records.en: Battle: Support Orders

records.jp: サポーターが発動できる支援スキルです。^00スキルごとに決められたオーダーリングの周回数と発動条件を満たすと、自動で発動します。^00サポートオーダーは、メインメニューの「パーティ」で付け替えることができます
records.en_original: These are support skills that can be activated by your Supporters. They are automatically activated when the required number of Order Ring cycles and the activation conditions for each skill have been met. Support Orders can be changed in the Main Menu under Party.
records.en_auxiliary: These are support skills that can be activated by your Supporters. They are automatically activated when the required number of Order Ring cycles and the activation conditions for each skill have been met. Support Orders can be changed in the Main Menu under Party.
records.en: Support Orders are support skills used by Supporters.^00They activate automatically once both the required number of Order Ring cycles and the skill's activation conditions have been met.^00Support Orders can be changed under Party in the Main Menu.

records.jp: 戦闘：アイテムの使用
records.en_original: Battle: Item Use
records.en: Battle: Item Use

records.jp: サポーターメニューでアイテムを設定することで、サポーターにアイテムを使ってもらうことができます。^00アイテムは<CLGR>オーダーリングが１周すると、自動で使用<CLNR>されます
records.en_original: You can have your Supporters use an item by choosing the item in the Supporter menu. The item will be automatically used <CLGR>after 1 cycle of the Order Ring<CLNR>.
records.en_auxiliary: You can have your Supporters use an item by choosing the item in the Supporter menu. The item will be automatically used <CLGR>after 1 cycle of the Order Ring<CLNR>.
records.en: Set an item in the Supporter Menu to have a Supporter use it.^00The item will be <CLGR>used automatically after the Order Ring completes one cycle<CLNR>.

records.jp: 戦闘：インファイトバトル開始条件
records.en_original: Battle: Initiating a One-on-One Battle
records.en: Battle: Initiating a One-on-One Battle

records.jp: 一部の敵は、ノックダウン時にバリアを展開します。^00バリアは攻撃することで破壊することができます。全てのバリアを破壊すると、インファイトバトルを仕掛けることができます
records.en_original: Some enemies will create barriers when in Knockdown. Barriers can be destroyed by attacking them. Once all barriers are destroyed, you can initiate a One-on-One Battle.
records.en_auxiliary: Some enemies will create barriers when in Knockdown. Barriers can be destroyed by attacking them. Once all barriers are destroyed, you can initiate a One-on-One Battle.
records.en: Some enemies deploy barriers when knocked down.^00Attack the barriers to destroy them. Once every barrier is destroyed, you can initiate One-on-One.

records.jp: 戦闘：敵から仕掛けるインファイトバトル
records.en_original: Battle: Enemy-Initiated One-on-One Battle
records.en: Battle: Enemy-Initiated One-on-One Battle

records.jp: 一部の敵は、ＨＰを一定以上まで減らすと、インファイトバトルを仕掛けてくることがあります
records.en_original: Some enemies may try to initiate a One-on-One Battle when their HP is reduced to a certain level.
records.en_auxiliary: Some enemies may try to initiate a One-on-One Battle when their HP is reduced to a certain level.
records.en: Some enemies may initiate One-on-One after their HP falls below a certain threshold.

records.jp: 戦闘：インファイトバトルについて
records.en_original: Battle: About One-on-One Battles
records.en: Battle: About One-on-One Battles

records.jp: インファイトバトルは、リアルタイムで進行する１対１のバトルです。^00どちらかのＨＰが０になるか、制限時間が過ぎると、インファイトバトルは終了になります
records.en_original: One-on-One Battles are fought in real time. The battle ends when either side's HP reaches 0 or the time limit is reached.
records.en_auxiliary: One-on-One Battles are fought in real time. The battle ends when either side's HP reaches 0 or the time limit is reached.
records.en: One-on-One is a real-time battle between a single ally and enemy.^00It ends when either side's HP reaches 0 or the time limit expires.

records.jp: 戦闘：ＨＰバリア
records.en_original: Battle: HP Barrier
records.en: Battle: HP Barrier

records.jp: 味方からインファイトバトルを仕掛けた場合に限り、自分のＨＰにバリアが張られます。^00バリアはＨＰの身代わりとなってダメージを受けてくれますが、<CLGR>バリアの耐久値が０になるとインファイトバトルは強制的に終了になります<CLNR>
records.en_original: When an ally initiates a One-on-One Battle, a barrier will be placed over your HP. This barrier will take damage instead of your HP, but <CLGR>when the barrier's durability is reduced to 0, the One-on-One Battle will be terminated<CLNR>.
records.en_auxiliary: When an ally initiates a One-on-One Battle, a barrier will be placed over your HP. This barrier will take damage instead of your HP, but <CLGR>when the barrier's durability is reduced to 0, the One-on-One Battle will be terminated<CLNR>.
records.en: Only when an ally initiates One-on-One will a barrier be placed over their HP.^00The barrier takes damage in place of HP, but <CLGR>One-on-One ends immediately if the barrier's durability reaches 0<CLNR>.

records.jp: 戦闘：インファイトバトル中のコマンド
records.en_original: Battle: One-on-One Battle Commands
records.en: Battle: One-on-One Battle Commands

records.jp: インファイトバトル中は、<IM00>で敵にダメージを与える攻撃スキル、<IM06>で自分に強化効果をかける補助スキルを発動できます。^00また、敵の攻撃に合わせて<IM02>を押すと回避ができます。さらに、タイミングはシビアですが、<IM04>でカウンターを行うこともできます。カウンターが成功すると、<CLGR>敵の攻撃を無効化し、大ダメージを与える<CLNR>ことができます。^00各コマンドは連続して使用することはできず、再使用可能になるまでの時間が設定されています
records.en_original: During One-on-One Battles, you can use <IM00> to activate attack skills that damage enemies, and <IM06> to activate support skills that boost your power. You can also use <IM02> to evade. In addition, you can use <IM04> to perform a counter. The timing is very important, but if the counter is successful, <CLGR>it will negate the enemy's attack and inflict a large amount of damage<CLNR>. Each command has a cooldown period and cannot be used consecutively.
records.en_auxiliary: During One-on-One Battles, you can use <IM00> to activate attack skills that damage enemies, and <IM06> to activate support skills that boost your power. You can also use <IM02> to evade. In addition, you can use <IM04> to perform a counter. The timing is very important, but if the counter is successful, <CLGR>it will negate the enemy's attack and inflict a large amount of damage<CLNR>. Each command has a cooldown period and cannot be used consecutively.
records.en: During One-on-One, use <IM00> for attack skills that damage the enemy and <IM06> for support skills that apply buffs to yourself.^00Press <IM02> in time with an enemy attack to evade. You can also counter with <IM04>, though the timing is strict. A successful counter <CLGR>negates the enemy's attack and deals heavy damage<CLNR>.^00Commands cannot be used repeatedly and each has its own cooldown.

records.jp: 戦闘：インファイトフィニッシュ
records.en_original: Battle: One-on-One Finisher
records.en: Battle: One-on-One Finisher

records.jp: インファイトバトルで制限時間終了まで戦い抜き、コンボを一定以上つなげると、<CLGR>強力なトドメ技・インファイトフィニッシュを放つ<CLNR>ことができます。^00インファイトフィニッシュに必要なコンボ数は、コンボ表示の下にあるゲージで確認できます
records.en_original: During a One-on-One Battle, if you fight until the time limit is reached and your combo count is over a certain number, you will be able to <CLGR>unleash a powerful One-on-One Finisher<CLNR>. The combo count required for the One-on-One Finisher can be seen in the gauge below the combo count.
records.en_auxiliary: During a One-on-One Battle, if you fight until the time limit is reached and your combo count is over a certain number, you will be able to <CLGR>unleash a powerful One-on-One Finisher<CLNR>. The combo count required for the One-on-One Finisher can be seen in the gauge below the combo count.
records.en: If you fight until the One-on-One time limit expires and build a sufficiently high combo, you can <CLGR>unleash the powerful finishing move One-on-One Finisher<CLNR>.^00The gauge below the combo display shows how many hits are required.

records.jp: 学校：学校でできること
records.en_original: School: Things You Can Do
records.en: School: Things You Can Do

records.jp: 学校では、一緒に生活しているキャラクターと会話をしたり、作業室で工作をしたりすることができます。^00学校でできることは、ストーリーの進行で増えていきます
records.en_original: At school, you can chat with the other girls, craft in the work room, and so on. You will be able to do more and more as the story progresses.
records.en_auxiliary: At school, you can chat with the other girls, craft in the work room, and so on. You will be able to do more and more as the story progresses.
records.en: At school, you can talk with the characters living alongside you and craft at the workroom desk.^00More activities become available as the story progresses.

records.jp: 学校：学校メニュー
records.en_original: School: School Menu
records.en: School: School Menu

records.jp: 学校で<IM11>を押すと、学校メニューを開きます。^00学校メニューからは学校の様々な場所へ移動したり、各種機能にアクセスすることができます
records.en_original: Press <IM11> while in the school to open the School menu. From the School menu, you can move to different locations around the school and access various functions.
records.en_auxiliary: Press <IM11> while in the school to open the School menu. From the School menu, you can move to different locations around the school and access various functions.
records.en: Press <IM11> at school to open the School Menu.^00From there, you can move to various locations around the school and access its different functions.

records.jp: 学校：ココロトープへの移動
records.en_original: School: Going to the Heartscape
records.en: School: Going to the Heartscape

records.jp: ココロトープへ移動する際は、中庭にある舵にアクセスします。^00ココロトープへの移動は、学校メニューからも行うことができます
records.en_original: To go to the Heartscape, use the ship's wheel found in the courtyard. You can also go to the Heartscape via the School menu.
records.en_auxiliary: To go to the Heartscape, use the ship's wheel found in the courtyard. You can also go to the Heartscape via the School menu.
records.en: Use the ship's wheel in the courtyard to travel to a Heartscape.^00You can also travel to Heartscapes from the School Menu.

records.jp: 学校：ＢＧＭ変更
records.en_original: School: Background Music
records.en: School: Background Music

records.jp: 放送室では、ゲーム中に流れるＢＧＭを変更することができます。^00ＢＧＭ変更メニューへは、学校メニューからもアクセスできます
records.en_original: You can change the background music that plays during the game in the broadcasting room. You can also access the background music via the School menu.
records.en_auxiliary: You can change the background music that plays during the game in the broadcasting room. You can also access the background music via the School menu.
records.en: You can change the BGM that plays during the game in the Broadcasting Room.^00The BGM menu can also be accessed from the School Menu.

records.jp: 学校：コスチューム変更
records.en_original: School: Changing Outfits
records.en: School: Changing Outfits

records.jp: 更衣室では、キャラクターの服装を変更することができます。^00コスチューム変更メニューへは、学校メニューからもアクセスできます
records.en_original: You can change the characters' outfits in the locker room. You can also access the outfits via the School menu.
records.en_auxiliary: You can change the characters' outfits in the locker room. You can also access the outfits via the School menu.
records.en: You can change each character's outfit in the Locker Room.^00The Outfit menu can also be accessed from the School Menu.

records.jp: 工作：工作の基本
records.en_original: Crafting: Crafting Basics
records.en: Crafting: Crafting Basics

records.jp: 工作は、作業室の机にアクセスすることで行えます。^00キャラクター同士で協力することで、材料を消費して新たなアイテムを作ることができます
records.en_original: Crafting can be done at the desk in the work room. By collaborating with other characters, you can use materials to create new items.
records.en_auxiliary: Crafting can be done at the desk in the work room. By collaborating with other characters, you can use materials to create new items.
records.en: Crafting is performed by accessing the desk in the workroom.^00Four characters work together to consume materials and create a new item.

records.jp: 工作：メモリー
records.en_original: Crafting: Memories
records.en: Crafting: Memories

records.jp: メモリーを獲得すると、新たなアイテムを工作できるようになります。^00メモリーは探索地で入手できることがあるほか、キャラクターからもらえることもあります
records.en_original: Acquiring memories will allow you to craft new items. Memories can be found while exploring, and can also be obtained from characters.
records.en_auxiliary: Acquiring memories will allow you to craft new items. Memories can be found while exploring, and can also be obtained from characters.
records.en: Obtaining a Memory unlocks a new item to craft.^00Memories can be found while exploring or received from characters.

records.jp: 工作：工作を行うメンバー
records.en_original: Crafting: Crafting Team
records.en: Crafting: Crafting Team

records.jp: 工作は、４人のキャラクターで協力して行います。^00選んだキャラクターに応じて、完成品の効果や品質が変化することがあります
records.en_original: Crafting is done through the collaboration of four characters. The effects and quality of the finished product may vary depending on the characters you choose.
records.en_auxiliary: Crafting is done through the collaboration of four characters. The effects and quality of the finished product may vary depending on the characters you choose.
records.en: Four characters cooperate on each crafting project.^00The finished item's effects and quality may change depending on the characters selected.

records.jp: 工作：アビリティ
records.en_original: Crafting: Abilities
records.en: Crafting: Abilities

records.jp: キャラクターは、工作時に発揮されるアビリティを持っています。^00アビリティを発生させることで、完成品に効果を付与したり、品質を上げたりすることができます。^00アビリティは、キャラクターのタレントを取得することで習得することができます。^00また、<CLGR>同一のアビリティを複数発生させることで、効果を上昇させる<CLNR>こともできます
records.en_original: Characters have abilities that are activated when crafting. Abilities can be triggered to add effects or increase the quality of the finished product. Abilities can be gained through learning talents. You can also <CLGR>trigger the same ability multiple times to increase its effects<CLNR>.
records.en_auxiliary: Characters have abilities that are activated when crafting. Abilities can be triggered to add effects or increase the quality of the finished product. Abilities can be gained through learning talents. You can also <CLGR>trigger the same ability multiple times to increase its effects<CLNR>.
records.en: Characters possess Abilities that activate during crafting.^00Triggering Abilities can add effects to the finished item or raise its quality.^00Abilities are learned by unlocking character Talents.^00Triggering <CLGR>the same Ability multiple times increases its effect<CLNR>.

records.jp: 工作：ユニット効果
records.en_original: Crafting: Unit Effects
records.en: Crafting: Unit Effects

records.jp: 工作を行うメンバーの組み合わせによって、ユニット効果が発生する場合があります。^00ユニット効果は、<CLGR>完成品が持っている特定の系統の効果に影響を与えます<CLNR>。^00一度発生したユニット効果は「ユニットを選ぶ」に保存されるため、そこから呼び出すこともできます
records.en_original: Depending on the combination of characters who are crafting, Unit Effects may be triggered. Unit Effects <CLGR>affect certain effect classes of the finished product<CLNR>. The Unit Effects that you have triggered before are saved in Choose Unit and can be selected again from there.
records.en_auxiliary: Depending on the combination of characters who are crafting, Unit Effects may be triggered. Unit Effects <CLGR>affect certain effect classes of the finished product<CLNR>. The Unit Effects that you have triggered before are saved in Choose Unit and can be selected again from there.
records.en: Certain combinations of crafting members can trigger Unit Effects.^00Unit Effects <CLGR>influence specific effect classes on the finished item<CLNR>.^00Once triggered, a Unit Effect is saved under Choose Unit and can be selected again from there.

records.jp: 工作：効果と効果系統
records.en_original: Crafting: Effects and Effect Class
records.en: Crafting: Effects and Effect Class

records.jp: 工作で作ったアイテムは、付与されている効果によって使用したときに発揮される力が決まります。^00効果には、メモリーによって決められたものと、アビリティによって付与されたものがあります。^00また、それぞれの効果には効果系統が設定されています。効果系統はユニット効果によって影響を受けます
records.en_original: The power of the items you craft is determined by their effects. There are effects that are established by memories and those that are granted by abilities. In addition, each effect has its own effect class, which is determined by the Unit Effect.
records.en_auxiliary: The power of the items you craft is determined by their effects. There are effects that are established by memories and those that are granted by abilities. In addition, each effect has its own effect class, which is determined by the Unit Effect.
records.en: The power an item displays when used is determined by the effects added during crafting.^00Some effects are fixed by the Memory, while others are granted by Abilities.^00Each effect also belongs to an effect class, which can be influenced by Unit Effects.

records.jp: お願い：少女たちのお願い
records.en_original: Requests: The Girls' Requests
records.en: Requests: The Girls' Requests

records.jp: 頭上に「？」アイコンが表示されたキャラクターに話しかけると、お願いを聞くことができます。^00お願いを叶えてあげることで、そのキャラクターのＴＰを獲得できます。また、アイテムやメモリーなどの報酬を獲得できる場合もあります
records.en_original: Characters with a ? icon above their head will ask you to do something for them. By fulfilling a character's request, you will gain TP for that character. You may also receive rewards such as items and memories.
records.en_auxiliary: Characters with a ? icon above their head will ask you to do something for them. By fulfilling a character's request, you will gain TP for that character. You may also receive rewards such as items and memories.
records.en: Talk to a character with a “?” icon above their head to hear their request.^00Fulfilling it grants TP for that character and may also reward items, Memories, or other bonuses.

records.jp: お願い：お願いメモ
records.en_original: Requests: Request List
records.en: Requests: Request List

records.jp: 受けたお願いは、メインメニューのお願いメモで確認できます
records.en_original: You can view a list of active requests in the Main Menu.
records.en_auxiliary: You can view a list of active requests in the Main Menu.
records.en: Accepted requests can be reviewed in Request Notes in the Main Menu.

records.jp: タレント：タレントの取得
records.en_original: Talents: Learning Talents
records.en: Talents: Learning Talents

records.jp: タレントでは、各キャラクターが所持しているＴＰを消費して、様々な能力を解放することができます。^00解放できる能力は、タレントタイプと呼ばれる４つの分類が設定されています。ロックされているタレントタイプは、物語の進行に応じて解放されていきます
records.en_original: You can use TP to unlock a variety of abilities for each character in Talents. There are four categories of abilities, called talent types, that can be unlocked. Different talent types will be unlocked as the story progresses.
records.en_auxiliary: You can use TP to unlock a variety of abilities for each character in Talents. There are four categories of abilities, called talent types, that can be unlocked. Different talent types will be unlocked as the story progresses.
records.en: Spend each character's TP in Talents to unlock various abilities.^00The available abilities are divided into four categories called Talent Types. Locked Talent Types open as the story progresses.

records.jp: タレント：ＴＰとタレントレベル
records.en_original: Talents: TP & Talent Levels
records.en: Talents: TP & Talent Levels

records.jp: ■ＴＰ^00キャラクターごとに蓄積するポイントです。お願いを叶えたり、デートをしたりすると、交流を深めた相手に付与されます。^00ただし、愛央のＴＰだけはお願いやデートでは付与されず、他のキャラクターのタレントレベルが上昇した際に付与されます。^00　^00■タレントレベル^00ＴＰの累計獲得量が一定数を超えると上昇します。^00タレントレベルが上昇すると様々な報酬をもらえます。また、タレントレベルに応じたタレントスキルを習得する場合もあります。
records.en_original: TP:^00Points accumulated by each character. Fulfilling a character's request or going on a date with them will deepen your relationship, granting them TP. However, Ao does not gain TP through requests or dates, but instead when other characters' Talent Level is increased.^00^00Talent Level:^00Increases when the cumulative amount of TP earned exceeds a certain number. As your Talent Level increases, you will receive various rewards. You may also learn new Talent Skills as your Talent Level increases.
records.en_auxiliary: TP:^00Points accumulated by each character. Fulfilling a character's request or going on a date with them will deepen your relationship, granting them TP. However, Ao does not gain TP through requests or dates, but instead when other characters' Talent Level is increased.^00^00Talent Level:^00Increases when the cumulative amount of TP earned exceeds a certain number. As your Talent Level increases, you will receive various rewards. You may also learn new Talent Skills as your Talent Level increases.
records.en: ■TP^00Points accumulated separately by each character. Fulfilling a request or going on a date grants TP to the character whose bond with Ao deepened.^00Ao does not gain TP from requests or dates; she gains it when another character's Talent Level rises.^00^00■Talent Level^00Rises once the character's cumulative TP reaches set thresholds.^00Raising Talent Level grants various rewards and may also teach Talent Skills tied to that level.

records.jp: 学校開発：学校開発の基本
records.en_original: School Development: Basics
records.en: School Development: Basics

records.jp: 学校開発は、作業室の机にアクセスすることで行えます。^00材料を消費して、様々な効果を持つ施設を開発することができます
records.en_original: School development can be done at the desk in the work room. You can use materials to build facilities with a variety of effects.
records.en_auxiliary: School development can be done at the desk in the work room. You can use materials to build facilities with a variety of effects.
records.en: Access the workroom desk to use School Development.^00Spend materials to develop facilities with a variety of effects.

records.jp: 学校開発：施設の提案
records.en_original: School Development: Facility Suggestions
records.en: School Development: Facility Suggestions

records.jp: 施設はキャラクターから提案を受けることで開発できるようになります。^00提案は物語を進めたり、お願いを聞いたりすることで受けられます
records.en_original: Facilities can be constructed by getting suggestions from the characters. You can get suggestions through the story or by listening to the girls' requests.
records.en_auxiliary: Facilities can be constructed by getting suggestions from the characters. You can get suggestions through the story or by listening to the girls' requests.
records.en: A facility becomes available for development after a character proposes it.^00New proposals are received by progressing the story or hearing requests.

records.jp: 学校開発：施設の強化
records.en_original: School Development: Upgrade Facility
records.en: School Development: Upgrade Facility

records.jp: 「施設の強化」では、材料を消費することで開発した施設を強化することができます。^00施設を強化することで、元の効果が強化されたり、新たな効果が追加されたりします
records.en_original: You can use materials to upgrade facilities you have constructed in Upgrade Facility. Upgrading a facility will improve its original effects or add new effects.
records.en_auxiliary: You can use materials to upgrade facilities you have constructed in Upgrade Facility. Upgrading a facility will improve its original effects or add new effects.
records.en: Upgrade Facility lets you spend materials to improve facilities you have developed.^00Upgrading strengthens their existing effects or adds new ones.

records.jp: 学校開発：施設効果
records.en_original: School Development: Facility Effects
records.en: School Development: Facility Effects

records.jp: 施設の効果には、ただ設置しただけで発動するものの他に、以下のような種類があります。^00　^00■次回適用効果^00設置した施設にアクセスし、特定のアイテムを消費することで発動します。^00効果は強力ですが、ココロトープから学校へ帰ってくると効果を失います。^00　^00■ＯＮ／ＯＦＦ効果^00設置した施設にアクセスし、効果をＯＮにすることで発動します。^00効果は強力ですが、同時にデメリット効果も受けてしまいます。^00　^00他にも、アクセスすることで、その場で効果が発動する施設もあります
records.en_original: In addition to effects that are granted simply by building a facility, the following effects are also possible.^00^00Delayed Effects:^00Triggered by accessing the facility and using a certain item. The effect is powerful, but it is lost when you return to the school from the Heartscape.^00^00ON/OFF Effects:^00Activated by accessing the facility and turning the effect on. The effect is powerful, but it also comes with a negative effect.^00^00There are also other facilities with effects that are activated on the spot when you access them.
records.en_auxiliary: In addition to effects that are granted simply by building a facility, the following effects are also possible.^00^00Delayed Effects:^00Triggered by accessing the facility and using a certain item. The effect is powerful, but it is lost when you return to the school from the Heartscape.^00^00ON/OFF Effects:^00Activated by accessing the facility and turning the effect on. The effect is powerful, but it also comes with a negative effect.^00^00There are also other facilities with effects that are activated on the spot when you access them.
records.en: Besides effects that activate simply by placing a facility, the following types also exist.^00^00■Next Excursion Effects^00Access the facility and consume a specified item to activate one.^00These effects are powerful, but expire when you return to school from a Heartscape.^00^00■ON/OFF Effects^00Access the facility and switch the effect ON to activate it.^00These effects are powerful, but also impose a disadvantage.^00^00Some facilities instead activate an immediate effect when accessed.

records.jp: 学校開発：セット効果
records.en_original: School Development: Set Effects
records.en: School Development: Set Effects

records.jp: 特定の組み合わせで施設を設置すると、セット効果が発動します。^00セットに含まれる施設を収納すると効果は失われますが、組み合わせは「発動中のセット効果」で確認できます
records.en_original: When you build a specific combination of facilities, a Set Effect will be activated. The effect will be lost when any of the facilities included in the set are stored. You can check the combinations in Sets in Effect.
records.en_auxiliary: When you build a specific combination of facilities, a Set Effect will be activated. The effect will be lost when any of the facilities included in the set are stored. You can check the combinations in Sets in Effect.
records.en: Placing a specific combination of facilities activates a Set Effect.^00Storing any facility in that set removes the effect, but the required combination can be checked under Active Set Effects.

records.jp: 学校開発：施設の移動・収納
records.en_original: School Development: Move/Store Facility
records.en: School Development: Move/Store Facility

records.jp: 「施設の確認」では、配置した施設の移動と収納ができます。^00収納した施設は「保管庫」から再配置できます
records.en_original: You can move and store the facilities you have built in Check Facility. Stored facilities can be put back via Storage.
records.en_auxiliary: You can move and store the facilities you have built in Check Facility. Stored facilities can be put back via Storage.
records.en: Check Facilities allows you to move or store placed facilities.^00Stored facilities can be placed again from Storage.

records.jp: フラグメント：フラグメント
records.en_original: Fragments: Fragments
records.en: Fragments: Fragments

records.jp: フラグメントは、キャラクターに装着することで効果を発揮します。装着はメインメニューの「フラグメント」から行えます。^00フラグメントの装着枠は、タレントの取得を進めることで増えていきます
records.en_original: Fragments can be equipped to characters to activate their effects. Fragments can be equipped in the Main Menu under Fragments. The number of Fragment slots available to each character will increase as you learn new Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: Fragments can be equipped to characters to activate their effects. Fragments can be equipped in the Main Menu under Fragments. The number of Fragment slots available to each character will increase as you learn new Talents.
records.en: Equip Fragments to characters to activate their effects. This can be done under Fragments in the Main Menu.^00Additional Fragment slots unlock as you acquire more Talents.

records.jp: フラグメント：サイズと発動ギア
records.en_original: Fragments: Size and Activation Gear
records.en: Fragments: Size and Activation Gear

records.jp: ■サイズ^00フラグメントの装着に必要な装着枠の数です。^00サイズが大きいものほど、同時に装着できるフラグメントの数は減りますが、その分強力な効果を持ちます。^00　^00■発動ギア^00フラグメントの効果が発動するギアです。^00発動ギアが高いものほど、効果が発動するのに時間がかかりますが、その分強力な効果を持ちます。
records.en_original: Size:^00The number of slots required to equip a Fragment. The larger the size, the fewer Fragments can be attached at once, but the more powerful the effects.^00^00Activation Gear:^00The Gear at which the Fragment's effect is activated. Effects with higher Activation Gears are more powerful, but take longer to activate.
records.en_auxiliary: Size:^00The number of slots required to equip a Fragment. The larger the size, the fewer Fragments can be attached at once, but the more powerful the effects.^00^00Activation Gear:^00The Gear at which the Fragment's effect is activated. Effects with higher Activation Gears are more powerful, but take longer to activate.
records.en: ■Size^00The number of slots required to equip the Fragment.^00Larger Fragments leave room for fewer simultaneous equips, but provide more powerful effects.^00^00■Activation Gear^00The Gear at which the Fragment's effect activates.^00Higher Activation Gears take longer to reach, but their effects are correspondingly stronger.

records.jp: フラグメント：効果タイプ
records.en_original: Fragments: Effect Types
records.en: Fragments: Effect Types

records.jp: フラグメントの持つ効果の種類です。効果名の上に記載されています。^00　^00攻撃　　　　：攻撃をする際に効果を発揮する。^00防御　　　　：攻撃を受ける際に効果を発揮する。^00回復　　　　：回復スキルを使った際に効果を発揮する。^00インファイト：インファイトバトル中に効果を発揮する。^00サポート　　：サポーターのときに効果を発揮する。^00スキル　　　：装着中のみ、設定されたスキルを使用できる。^00常時　　　　：常に効果を発揮する。
records.en_original: These are the types of effects that Fragments have. The type is listed above the effect name.^00^00Attack: Activated upon attacking.^00Defense: Activated upon being attacked.^00Recovery: Activated when using a recovery skill.^00One-on-One: Activated during One-on-One.^00Support: Activated when acting as a Supporter.^00Skill: Allows the designated skill to be used only while equipped.^00Permanent: Effect is always active.
records.en_auxiliary: These are the types of effects that Fragments have. The type is listed above the effect name.^00^00Attack: Activated upon attacking.^00Defense: Activated upon being attacked.^00Recovery: Activated when using a recovery skill.^00One-on-One: Activated during One-on-One.^00Support: Activated when acting as a Supporter.^00Skill: Allows the designated skill to be used only while equipped.^00Permanent: Effect is always active.
records.en: These are the types of effects a Fragment can have. The type is shown above the effect name.^00^00Attack: Activates when attacking.^00Defense: Activates when receiving an attack.^00Recovery: Activates when using a recovery skill.^00One-on-One: Activates during One-on-One.^00Support: Activates while the character is a Supporter.^00Skill: Allows the assigned skill to be used only while the Fragment is equipped.^00Always Active: Remains active at all times.

records.jp: デート：デート
records.en_original: Dates: Dates
records.en: Dates: Dates

records.jp: 学校にいるキャラクターに話しかけると、デートに誘うことができる場合があります。^00デート中にそのキャラクターが行きたい場所へ行くとイベントが発生し、イベント中の選択肢に応じてＴＰとフラグメントを獲得できます
records.en_original: When talking to a character at school, you may be able to ask them on a date. When you go to the place the character wants to go during the date, an event will occur, and you may be able to obtain TP and Fragments depending on the choices you make.
records.en_auxiliary: When talking to a character at school, you may be able to ask them on a date. When you go to the place the character wants to go during the date, an event will occur, and you may be able to obtain TP and Fragments depending on the choices you make.
records.en: Talking to a character at school may allow you to invite them on a date.^00Visit the place they want to go to trigger an event. Your choices during the event determine the TP and Fragments you receive.

records.jp: その他：セーブ・ロード
records.en_original: Other: Save/Load
records.en: Other: Save/Load

records.jp: メインメニューのセーブロードから、ゲームデータのセーブとロードを行うことができます
records.en_original: You can save and load your game with the Save/Load options in the Main Menu.
records.en_auxiliary: You can save and load your game with the Save/Load options in the Main Menu.
records.en: You can save and load your game with the Save/Load options in the Main Menu.

records.jp: その他：フォトモード
records.en_original: Other: Photo Mode
records.en: Other: Photo Mode

records.jp: <IM28>を押すと、フォトモードが起動します。^00フォトモード中は、カメラの移動やフィルタなどの調整の他、キャラクターやオブジェクトの配置や移動が行えます。^00調整が完了したらUIを非表示にし、撮影を行いましょう
records.en_original: Press <IM28> to enter Photo Mode. In Photo Mode, you can adjust camera placement and add filters, as well as place and move characters and objects. When you have finished making adjustments, hide the UI and take your picture!
records.en_auxiliary: Press <IM28> to enter Photo Mode. In Photo Mode, you can adjust camera placement and add filters, as well as place and move characters and objects. When you have finished making adjustments, hide the UI and take your picture!
records.en: Press <IM28> to start Photo Mode.^00You can move the camera, adjust filters, and place or reposition characters and objects.^00Once the setup is complete, hide the UI and take the photo.

records.jp: その他：フリスペ！
records.en_original: Other: FreeSpace
records.en: Other: FreeSpace

records.jp: <IM23>を押すと、フリスペ！の画面が開きます。^00ここでは過去のやり取りを閲覧できる他、キャラクターにチャット経由で話しかけることができます。^00また、「！」アイコンが表示されているキャラクターに話しかけると、攻略のヒントをもらえる場合があります
records.en_original: Use <IM23> to open FreeSpace. Here, you can view previous conversations between characters and chat with them directly. Try talking to characters with a ! for hints.
records.en_auxiliary: Use <IM23> to open FreeSpace. Here, you can view previous conversations between characters and chat with them directly. Try talking to characters with a ! for hints.
records.en: Press <IM23> to open FreeSpace.^00You can review earlier exchanges and speak to characters through chat.^00Talking to a character with a “!” icon may provide a gameplay hint.

records.jp: 戦闘：レゾナンスタイド
records.en_original: Battle: Resonance Tide
records.en: Battle: Resonance Tide

records.jp: 戦闘に参加するキャラクターのタレントの取得を進めると、愛央と協力して放つ必殺技<CLGR>レゾナンスタイド<CLNR>を習得できます。^00レゾナンスタイドは、愛央とそのキャラクターのギアが３以上のとき、コンボを一定以上つなげることで発動できます
records.en_original: As you gain more Talents by participating in battle, you can learn <CLGR>Resonance Tide<CLNR>, a special skill that can be unleashed in cooperation with Ao. Resonance Tide can be activated by achieving a combo of a certain level when Ao and the other character are in 3rd gear or higher.
records.en_auxiliary: As you gain more Talents by participating in battle, you can learn <CLGR>Resonance Tide<CLNR>, a special skill that can be unleashed in cooperation with Ao. Resonance Tide can be activated by achieving a combo of a certain level when Ao and the other character are in 3rd gear or higher.
records.en: Unlocking more Talents for a character who participates in battle teaches the special cooperative move <CLGR>Resonance Tide<CLNR>, performed together with Ao.^00It can be activated after reaching the required combo while both Ao and that character are at Gear 3 or higher.

records.jp: 探索：ステルスミッション
records.en_original: Exploration: Stealth Missions
records.en: Exploration: Stealth Missions

records.jp: ストーリー進行中や一部のお願い進行中、モンスターに見つかってはいけない<CLGR>ステルスミッション<CLNR>が始まることがあります。^00ステルスミッション中はフィールド上で武器を振ることができません
records.en_original: During some story missions and favors you may have to avoid being found by demons in a <CLGR>Stealth Mission<CLNR>. You cannot swing your weapon during Stealth Missions.
records.en_auxiliary: During some story missions and favors you may have to avoid being found by demons in a <CLGR>Stealth Mission<CLNR>. You cannot swing your weapon during Stealth Missions.
records.en: During parts of the main story and certain requests, a <CLGR>Stealth Mission<CLNR> may begin in which demons must not detect you.^00Weapons cannot be swung in the field during Stealth Missions.

records.jp: 戦闘：エーテルタイド
records.en_original: Battle: Ether Tide
records.en: Battle: Ether Tide

records.jp: 一定以上コンボを繋げることで、必殺技<CLGR>エーテルタイド<CLNR>を発動できるようになります。^00エーテルタイドは、条件を満たしたときに各キャラクターのスキルリストの一番上に表示されます
records.en_original: You can use <CLGR>Ether Tide<CLNR> by achieving a combo above a certain number. Once Ether Tide is available, it will be displayed at the top of each characters skill list.
records.en_auxiliary: You can use <CLGR>Ether Tide<CLNR> by achieving a combo above a certain number. Once Ether Tide is available, it will be displayed at the top of each characters skill list.
records.en: Build a combo above the required number to make the special move <CLGR>Ether Tide<CLNR> available.^00When its conditions are met, Ether Tide appears at the top of each character's skill list.

records.jp: 探索：ガイド機能
records.en_original: Exploration: Hints
records.en: Exploration: Hints

records.jp: 愛央の周りには、次の目的地へのガイドが表示される場合があります。^00ガイド機能は、あらすじ画面で<IM04>を押すことでＯＮ／ＯＦＦを切り替えられます
records.en_original: A hint showing the direction to Ao's next goal will occasionally be displayed. You can turn this off in the Summary screen with <IM04>.
records.en_auxiliary: A hint showing the direction to the next goal will occasionally be displayed. You can turn this off in the Summary screen with <IM04>.
records.en: A guide pointing toward Ao's next destination may appear around her.^00Press <IM04> on the Summary screen to toggle the Guide function ON or OFF.

records.jp: お願い：お願いのガイド機能
records.en_original: Requests: Request Hints
records.en: Requests: Request Hints

records.jp: お願いメモでお願いを選択して<IM04>を押すことで、目的地へのガイドを設定することができます。^00ただし「<CLRE>ガイド対象外<CLNR>」と書かれたお願いは、ガイドを設定することができません
records.en_original: You can show hints for a request by pressing <IM04> on the entry in the request list. However, hints are not available for some requests. These are marked with the text <CLRE>Hints Unavailable<CLNR>.
records.en_auxiliary: You can show hints for a request by pressing <IM04> on the entry in the request list. However, hints are not available for some requests. These are marked with the text <CLRE>Hints Unavailable<CLNR>.
records.en: Select a request in Request Notes and press <IM04> to set a guide to its destination.^00A guide cannot be set for requests marked “<CLRE>Guide Unavailable<CLNR>.”

records.jp: 探索：サーチモード
records.en_original: Exploration: Search Mode
records.en: Exploration: Search Mode

records.jp: 探索中、<IM02>を押すことで<CLGR>サーチモード<CLNR>に切り替えることができます。^00サーチモード中はダッシュができない代わりに^00敵シンボルの索敵範囲が見えるようになります
records.en_original: You can press <IM02> to activate <CLGR>Search Mode<CLNR>. Though you cannot dash while in Search Mode, you can see enemy symbols and their aggro range.
records.en_auxiliary: You can press <IM02> to activate <CLGR>Search Mode<CLNR>. Though you cannot dash while in Search Mode, you can see enemy symbols and their aggro range.
records.en: Press <IM02> while exploring to switch to <CLGR>Search Mode<CLNR>.^00You cannot dash in Search Mode, but^00enemy symbols' detection ranges become visible.

records.jp: 探索：バックアタック
records.en_original: Exploration: Back Attack
records.en: Exploration: Back Attack

records.jp: サーチモード中、敵に気付かれずに<IM04>で武器を当てると^00<CLGR>バックアタック<CLNR>を仕掛けることができます。^00バックアタックを行うと、敵がノックダウンしやすい^00状態で戦闘を開始することができます
records.en_original: You can get a <CLGR>Back Attack<CLNR> during Search Mode by hitting an unsuspecting enemy with your weapon using <IM04>. When successful, the enemy will be easier to Knockdown when battle begins.
records.en_auxiliary: You can get a <CLGR>Back Attack<CLNR> during Search Mode by hitting an unsuspecting enemy with your weapon using <IM04>. When successful, the enemy will be easier to Knockdown when battle begins.
records.en: While in Search Mode, hit an enemy with your weapon using <IM04> before it notices you^00to initiate a <CLGR>Back Attack<CLNR>.^00A successful Back Attack begins battle with the enemy^00more susceptible to Knockdown.

records.jp: 工作：エーテル合成
records.en_original: Crafting: Ether Synthesis
records.en: Crafting: Ether Synthesis

records.jp: エーテル合成では、不要な素材をエーテルに分解して再構築することで、入手したことのある他の素材を合成することができます。^00エーテルは赤・青・黄の３種類あります。素材ごとに分解時に入手できるエーテルと、合成に必要なエーテルが決まっています
records.en_original: Ether Synthesis allows you to break down materials that you no longer need into ether and reconstruct them as other materials that you've gathered before.^00There are three types of Ether: red, blue, and yellow. The amount of Ether that can be gained from breaking something down, and the amount required to synthesize something, are fixed for each material.
records.en: Ether Synthesis breaks unwanted materials down into Ether and reconstructs them as other materials you have obtained before.^00There are three colors of Ether: red, blue, and yellow. Each material has fixed Ether yields when broken down and Ether costs when synthesized.

records.jp: 南の隠れ島：宝珠
records.en_original: Hidden Island: Orbs
records.en: Hidden Island: Orbs

records.jp: 南の隠れ島のストーリーを進めていくと、３種の<CLGR>宝珠<CLNR>が手に入ります。^00広場の台座に宝珠をはめることで、島の天候や、時間帯を変えることができます
records.en_original: As you proceed through the Hidden Island story, you'll come upon three different <CLGR>orbs<CLNR>. Putting a orb into the pedestal will change the weather or time of day at the island.
records.en: Progressing through the Hidden Island story grants three different <CLGR>Orbs<CLNR>.^00Inserting an Orb into the pedestal in the plaza changes the island's weather or time of day.

records.jp: 南の隠れ島：連戦モード
records.en_original: Hidden Island: Survival Battles
records.en: Hidden Island: Survival Battles

records.jp: <CLGR>晴れの宝珠<CLNR>を台座にはめることで行えます。^00徐々に強くなる敵の集団との連戦を行うモードです。^00勝利すると、連続討伐数に応じて希少なアイテムを入手できます
records.en_original: Can be initiated when the <CLGR>Sun Orb<CLNR> is inserted into the pedestal.^00This battle mode pits you against swarms of enemies that gradually grow stronger and stronger. A rare item will be granted upon winning based on the number of enemies defeated.
records.en: Insert the <CLGR>Sun Orb<CLNR> into the pedestal to access this mode.^00Fight consecutive groups of enemies that gradually become stronger.^00Winning awards rare items according to the number defeated in succession.

records.jp: 南の隠れ島：ボスチャレンジ
records.en_original: Hidden Island: Boss Challenge
records.en: Hidden Island: Boss Challenge

records.jp: 影の少女に話しかけることで、９種類のボスとの戦闘に挑むことができます。^00９種類のボスを全て倒すと、さらに強化されたボスが登場します。最大５段階までボスは強化されます。^00勝利すると、特別なフラグメントを入手できます。^00また、勝利するたびにボスは強化され、より強力なフラグメントを入手できるようになります
records.en_original: By speaking with the shadow girl, you can challenge battling against 9 varieties of bosses.^00If you defeat all of them, even stronger powered-up bosses will appear. The bosses have a total of 5 levels in which they can be powered-up to.^00A special Fragment will be granted upon winning.^00The bosses will get stronger each time you beat them, and you can fight them again to earn a more powerful Fragment.
records.en: Speak to the shadow girl to challenge nine different bosses.^00After defeating all nine, stronger versions appear. Each boss can be strengthened through a maximum of five levels.^00Winning grants a special Fragment.^00Each victory strengthens the boss further and makes a more powerful Fragment available.

records.jp: 南の隠れ島：シャドウリフレクター戦
records.en_original: Hidden Island: Shadow Reflector Battle
records.en: Hidden Island: Shadow Reflector Battle

records.jp: <CLGR>自由の宝珠<CLNR>を台座にはめることで行えます。^00自分たちの影と戦うモードです。^00勝利すると、特別なフラグメントを入手できます
records.en_original: Can be initiated when the <CLGR>Freedom Orb<CLNR> is inserted into the pedestal.^00In this battle mode, the girls will fight against their shadows. A special Fragment will be granted upon winning.
records.en: Insert the <CLGR>Freedom Orb<CLNR> into the pedestal to access this mode.^00Fight against your own shadows.^00Winning grants a special Fragment.

records.jp: アトリエコラボ：錬金釜
records.en_original: Atelier Collab: Cauldron
records.en: Atelier Collab: Cauldron

records.jp: 学校開発施設の<CLGR>錬金釜<CLNR>にアクセスし、アイテムを消費すると、？？？のココロトープを変化させることができます。^00ココロトープを変化させることで、行けなかった場所へ行けるようになったり、採取ポイントが増えたりするようになります
records.en_original: You can change ???'s Heartscape by using certain items with the <CLGR>Cauldron<CLNR> facility in School Development.^00Changing the Heartscape will allow you to go places you were previously unable to go, as well as increase the number of collection points.
records.en: Access the <CLGR>Cauldron<CLNR> School Development facility and consume an item to alter ???'s Heartscape.^00Alterations can open previously inaccessible areas and add more gathering points.

records.jp: アトリエコラボ：錬金釜
records.en_original: Atelier Collab: Cauldron
records.en: Atelier Collab: Cauldron

records.jp: 学校開発施設の<CLGR>錬金釜<CLNR>にアクセスし、アイテムを消費すると、ライザのココロトープを変化させることができます。^00ココロトープを変化させることで、行けなかった場所へ行けるようになったり、採取ポイントが増えたりするようになります
records.en_original: You can change Ryza's Heartscape by using certain items with the <CLGR>Cauldron<CLNR> facility in School Development.^00Changing the Heartscape will allow you to go places you were previously unable to go, as well as increase the number of collection points.
records.en: Access the <CLGR>Cauldron<CLNR> School Development facility and consume an item to alter Ryza's Heartscape.^00Alterations can open previously inaccessible areas and add more gathering points.

records.jp: その他：難易度 マストダイ
records.en_original: Other: Deathwish Difficulty
records.en: Other: Deathwish Difficulty

records.jp: メインメニューの「コンフィグ」から、難易度を<CLGR>MUST DIE<CLNR>に変更できます。^00MUST DIEは、ハード以上に高い難易度であり、敵が大幅に強化されます。^00<CLRE>※MUST DIEは、クリア後に解禁になります<CLNR>
records.en_original: The difficulty can be set to <CLGR>Deathwish<CLNR> in the Config section of the Main Menu.^00The enemies in Deathwish will be even stronger than those in Hard.^00<CLRE>Deathwish will be unlocked after the game has been completed once.<CLNR>
records.en: Set the difficulty to <CLGR>Deathwish<CLNR> under Config in the Main Menu.^00Deathwish is harder than Hard and greatly strengthens enemies.^00<CLRE>Deathwish unlocks after clearing the game.<CLNR>

records.jp: その他：ヤギの育成
records.en_original: Other: Raising the Goat
records.en: Other: Raising the Goat

records.jp: ココロトープに住み着いたヤギに草を与えると、乳しぼりをさせてくれることがあります。^00乳しぼりをすると、<CLGR>ヤギミルク<CLNR>が入手できます。ヤギミルクを何度も入手することで、新しいアイテムの作り方を習得することもあります。^00草は、草むらに<IM04>でスイングを当てると入手できます
records.en_original: If the goat that lives in the Heartscape is given grass, it will provide milk.^00Milking the goat will produce <CLGR>Goat Milk<CLNR>, which can be used to make new items once it has been acquired enough times.^00Grass can be gathered by swinging your weapon with <IM04> in a grassy area.
records.en: Give grass to the goat living in the Heartscape and it may let you milk it.^00Milking grants <CLGR>Goat Milk<CLNR>. Obtaining Goat Milk repeatedly can also teach you how to craft new items.^00Grass is obtained by swinging with <IM04> at patches of grass.

records.jp: その他：フォトスタンプ
records.en_original: Other: Photo Stickers
records.en: Other: Photo Stickers

records.jp: フォトモードの「スタンプ」では、画面にスタンプを配置することができます。^00スタンプは最大１０個まで配置することが可能です。また、位置や大きさ、傾きなどを調整することができます
records.en_original: Stickers are images that you can add to photos taken in Photo Mode.^00Up to 10 stickers can be placed on one photo. The position, size, and angle of each sticker can be customized.
records.en: Select Stamp in Photo Mode to place stickers on the screen.^00You can place up to 10 and adjust their position, size, angle, and other settings.

records.jp: その他：次にやることの切替
records.en_original: Other: Changing Hints
records.en: Other: Changing Hints

records.jp: 本編と追加コンテンツの「次にやること」の表示を切り替えることができるようになりました。^00あらすじ画面でそれぞれのあらすじを選び、<IM04>を押すことで切り替えられます
records.en_original: The hint that appears above the map can be changed.^00You can choose which hint you want to display by selecting the corresponding Summary on the Summary screen and pushing <IM04>.
records.en: You can switch the displayed “Next Objective” between the main story and additional content.^00Select the corresponding summary on the Summary screen and press <IM04> to switch.
